transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm just... I'm just so worn out. I mean, even walking from the bedroom to the kitchen, it feels like I've been hauling lumber all day. And it doesn't matter how much I rest, I just don't get any energy back. That's really why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day?

Yeah, I have. It's pretty much all the time. I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling right in my chest, and it just doesn't lift. Some days... well, some days I just go sit out in the garage and cry. I don't even really know what starts it, honestly. It's just always there.
Have you lost interest in or pleasure from activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, pretty much everything. I used to really look forward to things like choir, playing pickup ball, working on cars... even just grilling out for the family. But lately... I just can't make myself care enough to do any of it. I don't show up anymore. People text me to see what's going on or invite me out, and I don't even have it in me to answer them. I just don't have the interest anymore.
How much do you find yourself worrying that your fatigue means you have a serious illness?

I don't really worry about that. I mean, I know I'm exhausted all the time, but I haven't really thought it was some kind of physical disease or anything. It's just... I'm just tired. I don't sit around thinking I have cancer or something, if that's what you mean.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been going on for about four months now. It really started around the time my wife went back to working full-time. So, you know, I've been spending most of the weekdays just... alone in the house. That's when it all kind of started.
How has your sleep been since these symptoms began?

It's been fine, really. I mean, I know I just said I'm exhausted all the time, but my actual sleep at night hasn't really changed. I go to bed, I sleep through the night, and I wake up. I don't really have any trouble falling asleep or anything like that. It's just regular sleep, I guess.
Have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty about yourself?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep thinking that I've completely failed my wife, my kids, and my church. It weighs on me a lot. Honestly, it feels like every bad thing happening around us right now is somehow a punishment for me. Like it's all happening because I'm not the man I was supposed to be.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself?

Yeah, I have. The thought just keeps coming to me that I should just be dead. It's... well, when I'm alone in the house all day, it really scares me, because I start thinking I might actually do something to make that happen.
Have you made a specific plan for how you would end your life?

No, I haven't. I mean, the thoughts are there, and they scare me, but... I haven't actually sat down and figured out how I would do it. I don't have a plan or anything like that. It's just the thoughts right now.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your ability to carry out your usual daily responsibilities?

It's... it's interfered a lot. I just can't manage the house anymore. I had all these plans to do handyman work, fix things up around here, but I can't follow through on any of it. I just sit here. And honestly, it's gotten to the point where my wife is scared to leave me alone. Like I said, I don't really trust myself when those thoughts get bad, and she knows that, so... yeah, I'm not really getting anything done.
